title: 1 Read the story.  Where does Jill live? Circle Jillâ€™s address in the story.

controls.text: 1 Read the story.  Where does Jill live? Circle Jill’s address in the story.

Jill went to the bakery to buy a cake. The bakery is two streets away from her house. On her way home, she got lost. She didn’t know how to get back home. She looked around. She was on Dove Street, but she lives in Walnut Street! She saw a girl walking nearby. ‘Excuse me,’ she said to the girl. ‘Could you please tell me how to get to 15 Walnut Street?’‘Sure!’ said the girl. ‘Walk along Dove Street. Take a right at Hamilton Street and walk along Hamilton Street. You will seeWalnut Street. Take a left at Walnut Street and 15 Walnut Street will be on the left.’‘Thank you very much!’ said Jill.‘You’re welcome,’ said the girl, as she waved. Jill was so happy to find the way to her house. Now she can go to the bakery and get home without getting lost again.

It’s raining today. My family and I stayed at home. I stayed in my bedroom. I played with my dolls and my toy poniesthat I have in my toy box. I like playing with dolls. My mum stayed in the kitchen and cooked dinner. She cooked it ina pot on the stove and baked a cake in the oven.

She also washed the clothes in the washing machine.We have a lot of clothes to wash. Dad fixed the tap in the bathroom. When he was done, he took a shower. My brother,Greg, sat on the sofa in the living room. He turned on the television and watched cartoons.When dinner was ready, Greg and I got the table in the dining room ready. We brought the plates, bowls and glasses.Dad brought

the forks and spoons. Mum brought the food from the stove. After we finished eating, Mum made tea. Dad took out thecake from the oven. We sat together to eat our cake and drink our tea. It was a good day!
